dn7:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Kosambiyaṃ viharati Ghositārāme.
dn7:1.4: Maṇḍisso ca paribbājako Jāliyo ca dārupattik-antevāsī yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu. Upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu,
dn7:1.5: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu. Ekamantaṃ thitā kho te dve pabbajitā Bhagavantaṃ etad avocuṃ:
dn7:1.6: ‘Kin nu kho āvuso Gotama taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīraṃ udāhu aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīran ti?'
dn7:1.7: ‘Tena h' āvuso suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasikarotha bhāsissāmīti.'
dn7:1.8: ‘Evam āvuso' ti kho te dve pabbajitā Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
dn7:2.1: ‘Idh' āvuso Tathāgato loke uppajjati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho . . .pe . . . yathā Sāmañña-phale evaṃ vitthāre tabbaṃ . . .
dn7:2.2: Evaṃ kho āvuso bhikkhu sīlasampanno hoti. . .
dn7:2.5: Yo nu kho āvuso bhikkhu evaṃ jānāti evaṃ passati, kallan nu kho tass' etaṃ vacanāya
dn7:2.6: "taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sariran" ti vā "aññaṃ jīvaṃ annaṃ sarīran" ti vā ti?'
dn7:2.7: ‘Yo so āvuso bhikkhu evaṃ jānāti evaṃ passati, kallaṃ tass' etaṃ vacanāya
dn7:2.8: "taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīran" ti vā "aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīran" ti vā ti.'
dn7:2.9: ‘Ahaṃ kho pan' etaṃ āvuso evaṃ jānāmi evaṃ passāmi.
dn7:2.11: "taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīran" ti vā "aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīran" ti vā. 3. ‘Dutiyajjhānaṃ . . . pe . . .
dn7:3.4: Yo nu kho āvuso bhikkhu evaṃ jānāti evaṃ passati, kallan nu kho tass' etaṃ vacanāya
dn7:3.5: "taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīran" ti vā "aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīran" ti vā ti?'
dn7:3.6: ‘Yo so āvuso bhikkhu evaṃ jānāti evaṃ passati, kallaṃ tass' etaṃ vacanāya
dn7:3.7: "taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīran" ti vā "aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīran" ti vā ti.'
dn7:3.8: ‘Ahaṃ kho pan' etam āvuso evaṃ jānāmi evaṃ passāmi,
dn7:3.10: "taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīran" ti vā "aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīran" ti vā. 4.
dn7:4.2: Yo nu kho āvuso bhikkhu evaṃ jānāti evaṃ passati, kallan nu kho tass' etaṃ vacanāya
dn7:4.3: "taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīran" ti vā "aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīran" ti vā ti?'
dn7:4.4: ‘Yo so āvuso bhikkhu evaṃ jānāti evaṃ passati, kallan tass' etaṃ vacanāya
dn7:4.5: "taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīran" ti vā "aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīran" ti vā ti.'
dn7:4.6: ‘Ahaṃ kho pan' etaṃ āvuso evaṃ jānāmi evaṃ passāmi,
dn7:4.8: "taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīran" ti vā "aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sariran" ti vā. 5.
dn7:5.2: Yo nu kho āvuso bhikkhu evaṃ jānāti evaṃ passati, kallan nu kho tass' etaṃ vacanāya
dn7:5.3: "taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīran" ti vā "aññam jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīran" ti vā ti?"
dn7:5.4: ‘Yo so āvuso bhikkhu evaṃ jānāti evaṃ passati, na kallaṃ tass' etaṃ vacanāya
dn7:5.5: "taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīran" ti vā "aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīran" ti vā ti.'
dn7:5.6: ‘Ahaṃ kho pan' etaṃ āvuso evaṃ jānāmi evaṃ passāmi,
dn7:5.8: "taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīran" ti vā "aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīran" ti vā ti.'
